tagline.en: Creative developer in Addis Ababa: interfaces, websites and the systems behind them

description.en: Ruth Mekonnen, creative developer in Addis Ababa. Selected work, case studies and how to reach her.
description.am: ሩት መኮንን፣ በአዲስ አበባ የፈጠራ ገንቢ። የተመረጡ ሥራዎች፣ ዝርዝር ጥናቶችና እሷን የሚያገኙበት መንገድ።

subheading.en: Creative developer in Addis Ababa. I design and build websites, products and the small details that make them feel alive.

description.en: A report people actually read, in print and as a scrolling story.

alt.en: The top corner of a black-and-white apartment block against a pale sky
alt.am: በፈዛዛ ሰማይ ፊት የጥቁርና ነጭ የመኖሪያ ሕንፃ የላይኛው ጥግ

description.en: The brief: show heavy 3D work without a heavy page. I built a viewer that streams each model only when you reach it, and a fallback image for slow phones. The site went from 9 MB to 600 KB on first load.
description.am: መመሪያው፦ ከባድ የ3D ሥራን ከባድ ባልሆነ ገጽ ማሳየት። እያንዳንዱን ሞዴል ሲደርሱበት ብቻ የሚያወርድ ማሳያና ለዝግተኛ ስልኮች ምትክ ምስል ሠራሁ። የመጀመሪያው ጭነት ከ9 MB ወደ 600 KB ወረደ።

alt.en: Five people around a white table in a bright meeting room
alt.am: በብሩህ የስብሰባ ክፍል ውስጥ በነጭ ጠረጴዛ ዙሪያ ያሉ አምስት ሰዎች

description.en: Shop owners checked sales in a notebook. I sat with six of them for a week, then designed a dashboard that answers their three real questions on one screen.
description.am: የሱቅ ባለቤቶች ሽያጭን በደብተር ይከታተሉ ነበር። ከስድስቱ ጋር ለአንድ ሳምንት ተቀምጬ፣ ሦስቱን እውነተኛ ጥያቄዎቻቸውን በአንድ ስክሪን የሚመልስ ዳሽቦርድ ነደፍኩ።

description.en: React, TypeScript, CSS that moves without hurting the page.
description.am: React፣ TypeScript፣ ገጹን ሳይጎዳ የሚንቀሳቀስ CSS።

description.en: Tokens, components and documentation teams actually use.
description.am: ቡድኖች በእርግጥ የሚጠቀሙባቸው ቶክኖች፣ ክፍሎችና ሰነዶች።

description.en: Small, purposeful animation, and none for those who ask for less.
description.am: ትንሽ፣ ዓላማ ያለው እንቅስቃሴ፣ ያነሰ ለሚፈልጉ ደግሞ ምንም።

description.en: Ge'ez type that reads well on every screen.
description.am: በሁሉም ስክሪን ላይ በደንብ የሚነበብ የግዕዝ ፊደል።

quote.en: The best interface is the one nobody has to think about, and everybody remembers.
quote.am: ምርጡ በይነገጽ ማንም ሊያስብበት የማይገባው፣ ሁሉም ግን የሚያስታውሰው ነው።

body.en: Tell me about it. I take on a few projects at a time.
